key: Fixed kitten distance travelled and fastest speed being measured relative to the sun. They are now relative to the body the vehicle is orbiting, or to the ground while landed.
english: Fixed kitten distance travelled and fastest speed being measured relative to the sun. They are now relative to the body the vehicle is orbiting, or to the ground while landed.
chinese: 修复小猫的行进距离和最高速度错误地相对太阳测量的问题。现在改为相对飞船所环绕的天体测量；着陆时则相对地面测量。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed the staging window and HUD delta-v pointing at the next sequence after loading a save.
english: Fixed the staging window and HUD delta-v pointing at the next sequence after loading a save.
chinese: 修复加载存档后，分级窗口和 HUD 的速度增量指向下一个序列的问题。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Added a unit test that restores the active sequence before any sequences are found, which reproduces the bug.
english: Added a unit test that restores the active sequence before any sequences are found, which reproduces the bug.
chinese: 新增单元测试：在尚未发现任何序列前恢复当前活动序列，以复现此问题。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed the Manifest window's distance and speed columns measuring from the camera in map view. They are now relative to the controlled vehicle, falling back to whatever the camera follows when nothing is controlled.
english: Fixed the Manifest window's distance and speed columns measuring from the camera in map view. They are now relative to the controlled vehicle, falling back to whatever the camera follows when nothing is controlled.
chinese: 修复地图视图中清单窗口的距离和速度列相对相机测量的问题。现在以受控飞船为参考；没有受控对象时，则以相机跟随的对象为参考。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Improved time warp speed with many vehicles in orbit. Checking whether two physics bubbles should merge looked up each bubble's on-rails orbit again for every pair, repeating a walk over its engines and flight computer tens of thousands of times a tick.
english: Improved time warp speed with many vehicles in orbit. Checking whether two physics bubbles should merge looked up each bubble's on-rails orbit again for every pair, repeating a walk over its engines and flight computer tens of thousands of times a tick.
chinese: 提高大量飞船在轨时的时间加速性能。此前检查两个物理气泡是否应合并时，每一对气泡都会重新查询各自的解析轨道，导致每个计算步重复遍历发动机和飞行计算机数万次。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed a crash when a kitten boards a vehicle that has the kitten as its target.
english: Fixed a crash when a kitten boards a vehicle that has the kitten as its target.
chinese: 修复小猫登上一艘正以该小猫为目标的飞船时发生崩溃的问题。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed the galactic plane tests failing after the Core mod's star binary was swapped to stars_20byte.bin. The tests now read the binary named in the Core mod's manifest instead of a hardcoded file, and read the current format with its magnitude scale header and per-star inverse distance.
english: Fixed the galactic plane tests failing after the Core mod's star binary was swapped to stars_20byte.bin. The tests now read the binary named in the Core mod's manifest instead of a hardcoded file, and read the current format with its magnitude scale header and per-star inverse distance.
chinese: 修复 Core 模组的恒星二进制文件更换为 stars_20byte.bin 后，银道面测试失败的问题。测试现在读取 Core 模组清单指定的文件，替代硬编码文件名，并支持当前格式的星等比例头和逐恒星逆距离数据。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed the ground track not matching the map view or the vehicle's actual path. It walked the orbit's cached line points as one full ellipse from periapsis.
english: Fixed the ground track not matching the map view or the vehicle's actual path. It walked the orbit's cached line points as one full ellipse from periapsis.
chinese: 修复地面轨迹与地图视图、飞船实际路径不一致的问题。此前将轨道缓存的折线点当作从近点开始的一整条椭圆遍历。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: It only drew the current orbit, ignoring planned burns. The ground track is now sampled in time along the same flight plans the map draws, following each planned burn's plan from its ignition and the burn's predicted path while the engine runs.
english: It only drew the current orbit, ignoring planned burns. The ground track is now sampled in time along the same flight plans the map draws, following each planned burn's plan from its ignition and the burn's predicted path while the engine runs.
chinese: 此前只绘制当前轨道，忽略计划中的点火。现在地面轨迹按时间沿地图所绘制的同一飞行计划采样：从各次点火时刻开始跟随对应计划，发动机工作期间则跟随该次点火的预测轨迹。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Added an ignition marker to the ground track at each planned burn, with a countdown, so the coast before the burn and the trajectory after it can be told apart.
english: Added an ignition marker to the ground track at each planned burn, with a countdown, so the coast before the burn and the trajectory after it can be told apart.
chinese: 在地面轨迹上为每次计划点火新增带倒计时的点火标记，以区分点火前的滑行段与点火后的轨迹。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed a craft carrying a kitten in a cargo bay exploding under thrust. With the kitten in contact the craft is stepped by the contact solver, which measures g-load against the velocities at the start of each step.
english: Fixed a craft carrying a kitten in a cargo bay exploding under thrust. With the kitten in contact the craft is stepped by the contact solver, which measures g-load against the velocities at the start of each step.
chinese: 修复货舱载有小猫的飞船在推力作用下爆炸的问题。小猫与飞船接触时，接触求解器负责步进飞船，并以每个计算步开始时的速度计算过载。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: When thrust carried the craft more than 2 km from the bubble origin, the origin was re-centred mid-step, shifting every body's velocity, and that shift was read as thousands of g.
english: When thrust carried the craft more than 2 km from the bubble origin, the origin was re-centred mid-step, shifting every body's velocity, and that shift was read as thousands of g.
chinese: 当推力使飞船离物理气泡原点超过 2 km 时，原点会在计算步中途重新居中，导致所有物体的速度一起偏移；这次偏移曾被误判为数千 g 的过载。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: The step's starting velocities now move with the origin, so re-centring is no longer measured as a load.
english: The step's starting velocities now move with the origin, so re-centring is no longer measured as a load.
chinese: 现在计算步的初始速度会随原点一同变换，重新居中不再被计为过载。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed a vehicle's orbit slowly rising with no thrust. A sun-tracking solar panel's angle kept growing with every orbit it tracked and once retracted it unwound to the nearest whole turn but waited for an angle of exactly zero, so it never finished retracting.
english: Fixed a vehicle's orbit slowly rising with no thrust. A sun-tracking solar panel's angle kept growing with every orbit it tracked and once retracted it unwound to the nearest whole turn but waited for an angle of exactly zero, so it never finished retracting.
chinese: 修复飞船在无推力时轨道缓慢升高的问题。太阳跟踪电池板的跟踪角度会随每圈轨道不断累积；收回时虽回转到最近的整圈，却一直等待角度精确归零，导致始终无法完成收回。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: The panel kept the craft off rails indefinitely where its orbit drifted and time warp slowed. The tracking angle is now kept within one turn and panels from existing saves finish retracting.
english: The panel kept the craft off rails indefinitely where its orbit drifted and time warp slowed. The tracking angle is now kept within one turn and panels from existing saves finish retracting.
chinese: 电池板使飞船一直无法切回解析轨道计算，造成轨道漂移和时间加速变慢。现在跟踪角度保持在一圈以内，旧存档中的电池板也能正常完成收回。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed "Applying surface motion to a single vehicle in a non-CCF frame" errors flooding the screen with debris on the surface. A physics bubble that split off another or was created for a vehicle on load, kept the frame it started with and a lone landed or floating vehicle was never moved to the planet-fixed frame, so it logged errors every step indefinitely. The bubble now switches to the planet-fixed frame before moving a vehicle along the surface.
english: Fixed "Applying surface motion to a single vehicle in a non-CCF frame" errors flooding the screen with debris on the surface. A physics bubble that split off another or was created for a vehicle on load, kept the frame it started with and a lone landed or floating vehicle was never moved to the planet-fixed frame, so it logged errors every step indefinitely. The bubble now switches to the planet-fixed frame before moving a vehicle along the surface.
chinese: 修复地面残骸导致“在非 CCF 参考系中对单艘飞船施加地表运动”错误刷屏的问题。分裂产生或加载飞船时创建的物理气泡保留了初始参考系，单独着陆或漂浮的飞船始终没有切到天体固连参考系，因而每步都报错。现在沿地表移动飞船前，气泡会先切换到天体固连参考系。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed the skygrid overlay drawing over the console and other windows. It drew on the layer above every window, and now draws on the same layer as orbits so windows cover it.
english: Fixed the skygrid overlay drawing over the console and other windows. It drew on the layer above every window, and now draws on the same layer as orbits so windows cover it.
chinese: 修复天空网格叠加在控制台和其他窗口上方的问题。此前它绘制在所有窗口之上的图层；现在与轨道处于同一图层，可被窗口正常遮挡。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed a crash opening Crew Assignment in the editor or launch window. A seat whose kitten was recorded against a different vehicle name left that kitten out of the seat's own list and the dropdown's fallback to its first entry never applied to struct options so it read an empty option and crashed.
english: Fixed a crash opening Crew Assignment in the editor or launch window. A seat whose kitten was recorded against a different vehicle name left that kitten out of the seat's own list and the dropdown's fallback to its first entry never applied to struct options so it read an empty option and crashed.
chinese: 修复在编辑器或发射窗口打开乘员分配时发生崩溃的问题。若座位上的小猫被记录在另一飞船名下，该座位自己的候选列表便不会包含它；下拉框回退到第一项的逻辑又未对结构体选项生效，读取空选项后便崩溃。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: The fallback now works for every option type, and a seat always lists the kitten sitting in it.
english: The fallback now works for every option type, and a seat always lists the kitten sitting in it.
chinese: 回退逻辑现在适用于所有选项类型，座位列表也始终包含实际坐在其中的小猫。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed a crash when a planned burn's +1 orbit button was pressed while the burn sat on an escape or hyperbolic path. That path has no orbital period so stepping the burn time by one orbit produced NaN. The period buttons are now disabled when there is no period.
english: Fixed a crash when a planned burn's +1 orbit button was pressed while the burn sat on an escape or hyperbolic path. That path has no orbital period so stepping the burn time by one orbit produced NaN. The period buttons are now disabled when there is no period.
chinese: 修复在逃逸或双曲线路径上，为计划点火按下“+1 圈轨道”按钮时崩溃的问题。此类路径没有轨道周期，按一圈平移点火时间会产生 NaN。现在无周期时会禁用周期调整按钮。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed dragging a HUD panel pressing the buttons the cursor crossed. A button held under the cursor counted as pressed even when the press began elsewhere so a drag over a repeating button fired it and a drag ending over a button activated it. Buttons now act only when pressed on themselves.
english: Fixed dragging a HUD panel pressing the buttons the cursor crossed. A button held under the cursor counted as pressed even when the press began elsewhere so a drag over a repeating button fired it and a drag ending over a button activated it. Buttons now act only when pressed on themselves.
chinese: 修复拖动 HUD 面板时误触光标经过的按钮的问题。此前即使按下操作始于别处，光标下的按钮仍被视为已按下，拖过连发按钮或在按钮上结束拖动都会触发它。现在只有直接在按钮上按下才会生效。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed a crash in the vehicle editor when attaching a part that has symmetry copies onto a symmetric part. Each copy's parent was looked up in the target's symmetry group and a copy mounted outside that group (or not mounted at all) produced a negative index. Such copies are now skipped.
english: Fixed a crash in the vehicle editor when attaching a part that has symmetry copies onto a symmetric part. Each copy's parent was looked up in the target's symmetry group and a copy mounted outside that group (or not mounted at all) produced a negative index. Such copies are now skipped.
chinese: 修复在飞船编辑器中，把带对称副本的部件连接到对称部件时崩溃的问题。此前从目标对称组查找每个副本的父部件，若副本装在组外或尚未安装，会得到负索引。现在会跳过这些副本。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Bending a fuel hose in the editor now bends its symmetry copies to match. Adding, moving or deleting a bend node on a hose placed under symmetry applies the same change to every copy, rotated to match it.
english: Bending a fuel hose in the editor now bends its symmetry copies to match. Adding, moving or deleting a bend node on a hose placed under symmetry applies the same change to every copy, rotated to match it.
chinese: 在编辑器中弯折燃料软管时，其对称副本现在会同步弯折。对按对称方式放置的软管新增、移动或删除弯折节点，都会将同一改动旋转后应用到各个副本。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Update to latest Brutal packages
english: Update to latest Brutal packages
chinese: 更新到最新 BRUTAL 依赖包。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Minor tweaks, warning fixes, profiler tweaks
english: Minor tweaks, warning fixes, profiler tweaks
chinese: 进行少量调整、修复警告，并调整性能分析器。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Changed the Transfer Planner's Interstellar plan to let you set a target periapsis at the destination star again. The speed-up burn is aimed so that it arrives at that periapsis, and the slow-down burn ends there.
english: Changed the Transfer Planner's Interstellar plan to let you set a target periapsis at the destination star again. The speed-up burn is aimed so that it arrives at that periapsis, and the slow-down burn ends there.
chinese: 调整转移规划器的星际计划，恢复设置目的恒星目标近点距离的功能。加速点火会瞄准该近点到达，减速点火则在该处结束。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Changed the Transfer Planner's Interstellar destinations to list each star rather than a multiple system's barycenter, so Alpha Centauri A, B and Proxima can each be chosen. A star of a multiple system is aimed at where it will be on arrival, and the target periapsis is limited to half the star's sphere of influence.
english: Changed the Transfer Planner's Interstellar destinations to list each star rather than a multiple system's barycenter, so Alpha Centauri A, B and Proxima can each be chosen. A star of a multiple system is aimed at where it will be on arrival, and the target periapsis is limited to half the star's sphere of influence.
chinese: 调整星际目的地列表，逐颗列出恒星，而非多星系统的质心，因此可分别选择半人马座 α A、B 和比邻星。多星系统中的恒星以到达时的位置作为瞄准点，目标近点距离上限为该恒星作用范围半径的一半。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed Interstellar plans to Alpha Centauri A or B failing at 0.05 c and faster. The unaimed path passed several AU wide of the star's small sphere of influence, so there was nothing to correct the aim from. The aim is now corrected from how closely the path passes the star until it enters that sphere of influence.
english: Fixed Interstellar plans to Alpha Centauri A or B failing at 0.05 c and faster. The unaimed path passed several AU wide of the star's small sphere of influence, so there was nothing to correct the aim from. The aim is now corrected from how closely the path passes the star until it enters that sphere of influence.
chinese: 修复以 0.05 c 或更高速度前往半人马座 α A、B 的星际计划失败的问题。未经瞄准修正的路径会从恒星较小的作用范围外数 AU 处经过，无法据此修正瞄准。现在会根据路径与恒星的最近距离持续修正，直到路径进入其作用范围。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Changed Neptune to load from the shared body library in every Sol system, rather than each system keeping its own copy.
english: Changed Neptune to load from the shared body library in every Sol system, rather than each system keeping its own copy.
chinese: 调整海王星的加载方式：所有太阳系预设均从共享天体库加载，不再各自保留一份副本。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Changed KSA on Linux to start on X11 by default, using XWayland on a Wayland desktop, so detached windows work without any launch option.
english: Changed KSA on Linux to start on X11 by default, using XWayland on a Wayland desktop, so detached windows work without any launch option.
chinese: Linux 版 KSA 现在默认以 X11 启动；在 Wayland 桌面上使用 XWayland，因此无需启动参数即可使用独立窗口。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: If X11 can't start, such as on a Wayland desktop without XWayland, it falls back to the platform GLFW would have chosen.
english: If X11 can't start, such as on a Wayland desktop without XWayland, it falls back to the platform GLFW would have chosen.
chinese: 如果 X11 无法启动，例如 Wayland 桌面未安装 XWayland，则回退到 GLFW 默认选择的平台。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

english: Added the -wayland launch option to run on native Wayland instead. Detached windows are still turned off there, because Wayland can't position windows. -force-x11 is still accepted but no longer needed.
chinese: 新增 -wayland 启动参数，用于改用原生 Wayland。由于 Wayland 无法指定窗口位置，在该模式下仍禁用独立窗口。-force-x11 仍可使用，但已不再必需。

key: Changed the KSA launch profile for devs to no longer pass -force-x11, and added a "KSA (Wayland)" profile that passes -wayland.
english: Changed the KSA launch profile for devs to no longer pass -force-x11, and added a "KSA (Wayland)" profile that passes -wayland.
chinese: 调整开发者使用的 KSA 启动配置，不再传入 -force-x11；新增传入 -wayland 的“KSA (Wayland)”配置。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Added radiation. A vehicle's dose rate now comes from the radiation belts of magnetised planets, from its star's particle wind, and from cosmic rays.
english: Added radiation. A vehicle's dose rate now comes from the radiation belts of magnetised planets, from its star's particle wind, and from cosmic rays.
chinese: 新增辐射系统。飞船的辐射剂量率现在由有磁场行星的辐射带、所在恒星的粒子风和宇宙射线共同决定。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: A new Radiation gauge shows the current dose in mSv/h and the average over the current orbit.
english: A new Radiation gauge shows the current dose in mSv/h and the average over the current orbit.
chinese: 新增辐射仪表，以 mSv/h 显示当前剂量率和当前轨道的平均剂量率。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Added magnetospheres to Mercury, Earth, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune. Each one has its magnetic pole position, field strength and belts.
english: Added magnetospheres to Mercury, Earth, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune. Each one has its magnetic pole position, field strength and belts.
chinese: 为水星、地球、木星、土星、天王星和海王星新增磁层；每个天体均定义了磁极位置、磁场强度和辐射带。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: The solar wind pushes the field in on the day side so how far it reaches depends on the star's wind and the planet's distance. Belt strengths are approximate placeholders.
english: The solar wind pushes the field in on the day side so how far it reaches depends on the star's wind and the planet's distance. Belt strengths are approximate placeholders.
chinese: 太阳风会压缩昼侧磁场，因此磁层的延伸范围取决于恒星风和行星距离。辐射带强度目前仍是粗略的占位值。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Added space weather to stars: a quiet particle dose and a wind pressure at 1 AU, both weakening with distance. The Sun uses roughly real values, and the other stars have placeholder guesses. Eventually we want to implement solar weather here so that it fluctuates with solar events.
english: Added space weather to stars: a quiet particle dose and a wind pressure at 1 AU, both weakening with distance. The Sun uses roughly real values, and the other stars have placeholder guesses. Eventually we want to implement solar weather here so that it fluctuates with solar events.
chinese: 为恒星新增空间天气参数：在 1 AU 处的平静期粒子辐射剂量和风压，两者均随距离增大而减弱。太阳采用大致符合实际的数值，其他恒星暂用估计值。最终希望让这里的太阳天气随太阳活动事件变化。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Added a Magnetospheres option to the Map View window, turned off by default. It draws each magnetised planet's radiation belts as a shaded volume with dose contours along with its closed field lines, tail, magnetopause and bow shock. All of these are shaped by the star's wind.
english: Added a Magnetospheres option to the Map View window, turned off by default. It draws each magnetised planet's radiation belts as a shaded volume with dose contours along with its closed field lines, tail, magnetopause and bow shock. All of these are shaped by the star's wind.
chinese: 在地图视图窗口新增“磁层”选项，默认关闭。它会将有磁场行星的辐射带绘制为带剂量等值线的着色体积，同时显示闭合磁力线、磁尾、磁层顶和弓形激波；这些结构的形状均受恒星风影响。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Added aurora to Earth. Glowing ovals around each magnetic pole, between 90 and 400 km, visible from the ground and from orbit including over the cloud tops. They can be turned off with a new Aurora settings option under Graphics - Volumetrics.
english: Added aurora to Earth. Glowing ovals around each magnetic pole, between 90 and 400 km, visible from the ground and from orbit including over the cloud tops. They can be turned off with a new Aurora settings option under Graphics - Volumetrics.
chinese: 为地球新增极光：围绕各磁极、位于 90 至 400 km 高度的发光椭圆带，可从地面和轨道观察，也会显示在云层上方。可在“图形 - 体积效果”下通过新增的“极光”设置关闭。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Changed the Map View window to the new console style. This somehow got missed.
english: Changed the Map View window to the new console style. This somehow got missed.
chinese: 将地图视图窗口改为新的控制台风格，此前遗漏了这个窗口。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: ● ~* Changed aurora to show in debug builds only, along with its Aurora option under Graphics - Volumetrics, until its shaders have been reworked.
english: ● ~* Changed aurora to show in debug builds only, along with its Aurora option under Graphics - Volumetrics, until its shaders have been reworked.
chinese: ● ~* 暂时将极光及“图形 - 体积效果”下的极光选项限制为仅在调试构建中显示，等待重做着色器。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed speckled noise in the aurora when viewed from inside the aurora layer or from a distance.
english: Fixed speckled noise in the aurora when viewed from inside the aurora layer or from a distance.
chinese: 修复从极光层内部或远处观察时出现斑点噪声的问题。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Changed aurora to look more like reference data. arcs fold into curls and ribbons with bright patches that come and go. Rays are narrower and carry the green higher with red tops and the red now fades out by 600 km instead of ending at a hard edge at 400 km.
english: Changed aurora to look more like reference data. arcs fold into curls and ribbons with bright patches that come and go. Rays are narrower and carry the green higher with red tops and the red now fades out by 600 km instead of ending at a hard edge at 400 km.
chinese: 调整极光，使其更符合参考数据：弧带折叠为卷曲和飘带，亮斑时隐时现；光线更细，绿色延伸得更高，顶部呈红色。红色现在逐渐淡出至 600 km，而不再于 400 km 处硬性截断。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Added airglow. A thin green and orange line along the night-side horizon at about 90-100 km seen from orbit with the aurora rising out of it.
english: Added airglow. A thin green and orange line along the night-side horizon at about 90-100 km seen from orbit with the aurora rising out of it.
chinese: 新增气辉。从轨道观察时，可在约 90-100 km 高度的夜侧地平线上看到一条细薄的绿橙色光带，极光从中向上延伸。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed aurora being cut off below the horizon when viewed from orbit the height of its colour bands changing as the camera passed 250 km and distant aurora being lower quality than close up.
english: Fixed aurora being cut off below the horizon when viewed from orbit the height of its colour bands changing as the camera passed 250 km and distant aurora being lower quality than close up.
chinese: 修复从轨道观察时极光在地平线下被截断、相机经过 250 km 高度时色带高度变化，以及远处极光质量低于近处的问题。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Ground Clutter in Multiple Viewports
english: Ground Clutter in Multiple Viewports
chinese: 多视口中的地表杂物
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Added initial ground clutter rendering into multiple viewports. Currently culling and LOD fading is shared with the main camera for the initial implementation.
english: Added initial ground clutter rendering into multiple viewports. Currently culling and LOD fading is shared with the main camera for the initial implementation.
chinese: 初步支持在多个视口渲染地表杂物。此初始实现的剔除和细节层级渐变仍与主相机共享。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Changed PrepareInstances from outputting pure ego positions to ego rotation/scale and a translation relative to the clutter cell anchor. This means multiple viewports can share the same instance data.
english: Changed PrepareInstances from outputting pure ego positions to ego rotation/scale and a translation relative to the clutter cell anchor. This means multiple viewports can share the same instance data.
chinese: 调整 PrepareInstances：输出由纯 EGO 位置改为 EGO 旋转/缩放，加上相对杂物单元锚点的平移，从而让多个视口共享同一份实例数据。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed LOD fade data shared between viewports. Each viewport gets its own block now.
english: Fixed LOD fade data shared between viewports. Each viewport gets its own block now.
chinese: 修复视口间共享细节层级渐变数据的问题；现在每个视口各有一块独立数据。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Fixed ground clutter culling data shared between viewports.
english: Fixed ground clutter culling data shared between viewports.
chinese: 修复地表杂物剔除数据在多个视口间共享的问题。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Moved mesh geometry buffers into their own descriptor sets and built the sets once when the planet renderer starts up.
english: Moved mesh geometry buffers into their own descriptor sets and built the sets once when the planet renderer starts up.
chinese: 将网格几何缓冲区移入各自的描述符集，并在行星渲染器启动时一次性构建这些集合。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Avoided rebinding the mesh geometry descriptor write at runtime in favour of just binding the relevant set for the cubemesh LOD we want to render.
english: Avoided rebinding the mesh geometry descriptor write at runtime in favour of just binding the relevant set for the cubemesh LOD we want to render.
chinese: 避免在运行时重新绑定网格几何描述符写入，改为仅绑定待渲染立方球面网格细节层级对应的描述符集。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Added initial ground clutter generation to multiple viewports. Secondary viewports can now request ground clutter generation. The desired chunks of clutter are filtered before generation to prevent a viewport from re-generating a chunk that already exists. Ecotypes that don't have collisions (snap-to-mesh) don't use shared residency because they depend on the spherical billboarded mesh which is different per-viewport.
english: Added initial ground clutter generation to multiple viewports. Secondary viewports can now request ground clutter generation. The desired chunks of clutter are filtered before generation to prevent a viewport from re-generating a chunk that already exists. Ecotypes that don't have collisions (snap-to-mesh) don't use shared residency because they depend on the spherical billboarded mesh which is different per-viewport.
chinese: 初步支持多个视口生成地表杂物。次视口现在也可请求生成；生成前会筛选所需区块，避免重复生成已有区块。无碰撞、贴合网格的生态类型不共享驻留数据，因为其依赖的球面公告板网格在各视口中不同。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Sized ground clutter buffers for the max number of viewports, bringing the VRAM for trees up from ~130 to 1200Mb. This needs to be reduced.
english: Sized ground clutter buffers for the max number of viewports, bringing the VRAM for trees up from ~130 to 1200Mb. This needs to be reduced.
chinese: 按最大视口数量分配地表杂物缓冲区，使树木显存用量从约 130Mb 增至 1200Mb；仍需降低。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Added additional profiler markers around ground clutter preparation.
english: Added additional profiler markers around ground clutter preparation.
chinese: 在地表杂物准备阶段增加更多性能分析标记。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Reorganized ground clutter generation when multiple viewports are open, so the terrain mesh doesn't need building twice (once for terrain, once for ground clutter) per viewport. Terrain is now built once per viewport again.
english: Reorganized ground clutter generation when multiple viewports are open, so the terrain mesh doesn't need building twice (once for terrain, once for ground clutter) per viewport. Terrain is now built once per viewport again.
chinese: 重新组织多视口下的地表杂物生成，使每个视口无需分别为地形和杂物各构建一次地形网格。现在每个视口重新只构建一次地形。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Decoupled ground clutter generation checks from the main viewport's celestial.
english: Decoupled ground clutter generation checks from the main viewport's celestial.
chinese: 将地表杂物生成检查与主视口所处的天体解耦。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Reduced iteration count when checking if ground clutter ecotypes are valid for processing.
english: Reduced iteration count when checking if ground clutter ecotypes are valid for processing.
chinese: 减少检查地表杂物生态类型是否可处理时的迭代次数。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Split ground clutter matrices updates into a per-viewport update and a per-planet update, so the ground clutter main update no longer depends on viewport.
english: Split ground clutter matrices updates into a per-viewport update and a per-planet update, so the ground clutter main update no longer depends on viewport.
chinese: 将地表杂物矩阵更新拆分为逐视口更新和逐行星更新，使杂物的主要更新不再依赖视口。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Issued fewer FillBuffer calls for ground clutter instead of one per cell when unloading.
english: Issued fewer FillBuffer calls for ground clutter instead of one per cell when unloading.
chinese: 减少地表杂物卸载时的 FillBuffer 调用次数，不再每个单元调用一次。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Skipped ground clutter unloading if buffer IDs were recycled, since the GPU overwrites the instance count for a cell.
english: Skipped ground clutter unloading if buffer IDs were recycled, since the GPU overwrites the instance count for a cell.
chinese: 缓冲区 ID 被复用时跳过地表杂物卸载，因为 GPU 会覆盖该单元的实例数量。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Readded skipping ground clutter work when a viewport is outside an ecotype's render distance or there are no loaded cells.
english: Readded skipping ground clutter work when a viewport is outside an ecotype's render distance or there are no loaded cells.
chinese: 恢复以下跳过逻辑：当视口超出生态类型的渲染距离，或没有已加载单元时，不执行地表杂物工作。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Replaced expensive GetEffectiveNearbyCelestial calls in the ground clutter renderer with the cached celestial per viewport.
english: Replaced expensive GetEffectiveNearbyCelestial calls in the ground clutter renderer with the cached celestial per viewport.
chinese: 将地表杂物渲染器中开销较高的 GetEffectiveNearbyCelestial 调用替换为各视口缓存的天体。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Significantly optimized ground clutter VRAM usage. For 8 viewports, Earth's clutter VRAM usage has dropped from 1800Mb to 300Mb. Before these changes, Earth used 240Mb for a single viewport, meaning supporting 8 viewports all generating and rendering ground clutter only costs 60Mb more!
english: Significantly optimized ground clutter VRAM usage. For 8 viewports, Earth's clutter VRAM usage has dropped from 1800Mb to 300Mb. Before these changes, Earth used 240Mb for a single viewport, meaning supporting 8 viewports all generating and rendering ground clutter only costs 60Mb more!
chinese: 显著优化地表杂物显存用量。在 8 个视口下，地球杂物显存从 1800Mb 降至 300Mb。改动前地球单视口使用 240Mb，因此支持 8 个视口同时生成和渲染地表杂物，只多用 60Mb！
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Removed directions and height-and-gradients buffers from the ecotype and onto the ground clutter renderer as scratch buffers. Previously these were sized for the entire ecotype's kernel when they're just used as intermediates.
english: Removed directions and height-and-gradients buffers from the ecotype and onto the ground clutter renderer as scratch buffers. Previously these were sized for the entire ecotype's kernel when they're just used as intermediates.
chinese: 将方向缓冲区及高度与梯度缓冲区从生态类型移到地表杂物渲染器，作为临时缓冲区。此前虽只用作中间数据，却按整个生态类型的处理范围分配。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Split ground clutter generation up into batches of 256 chunks at one time. All chunks are still submitted in a frame, but this means the scratch buffers can be sized for a batch rather than the entire kernel.
english: Split ground clutter generation up into batches of 256 chunks at one time. All chunks are still submitted in a frame, but this means the scratch buffers can be sized for a batch rather than the entire kernel.
chinese: 将地表杂物生成拆为每批 256 个区块。所有区块仍会在一帧内提交，但临时缓冲区可按单批而非整个处理范围分配。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Compacted ground clutter object data size from 64 bytes per instance to 32 bytes per instance.
english: Compacted ground clutter object data size from 64 bytes per instance to 32 bytes per instance.
chinese: 将每个地表杂物实例的对象数据大小从 64 字节压缩至 32 字节。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Removed redundant PrepareInstances pass for static clutter. It existed to transform the CCF instance data to EGO and build the final transforms, but it turns out doing this in the vertex shader and avoiding the EGO buffer intermediate is just as fast - Some of the new arithmetic is probably hidden by other memory fetches.
english: Removed redundant PrepareInstances pass for static clutter. It existed to transform the CCF instance data to EGO and build the final transforms, but it turns out doing this in the vertex shader and avoiding the EGO buffer intermediate is just as fast - Some of the new arithmetic is probably hidden by other memory fetches.
chinese: 移除静态杂物中多余的 PrepareInstances 阶段。该阶段原用于将 CCF 实例数据转换到 EGO 并构建最终变换；实际在顶点着色器中完成此工作、避免 EGO 中间缓冲区，同样快。部分新增运算可能被其他内存读取延迟掩盖。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。

key: Changed the release build to compile with full compiler optimisations. Every build shipped until now ran without them, so the game was doing more CPU work than it needed to everywhere. Expect higher and steadier frame rates, fewer stutters in busy scenes, and shorter loading times. The gain is largest where the CPU was the limit, such as big vessels, dense maps and timewarp, and smallest where the GPU already was.
english: Changed the release build to compile with full compiler optimisations. Every build shipped until now ran without them, so the game was doing more CPU work than it needed to everywhere. Expect higher and steadier frame rates, fewer stutters in busy scenes, and shorter loading times. The gain is largest where the CPU was the limit, such as big vessels, dense maps and timewarp, and smallest where the GPU already was.
chinese: 正式构建现在启用完整编译器优化。此前发布的所有构建均未启用，导致 CPU 在各处执行了不必要的工作。预期帧率更高且更稳定、繁忙场景卡顿更少、加载更快；大型飞船、密集地图和时间加速等受 CPU 限制的场景收益最大，原本受 GPU 限制的场景收益最小。
notes: 按当前更新正文逐条核对；保留技术身份、数值、单位和开发过程中的先后改动。原文以 mSv/h 表示的 dose 按实际量译为剂量率。
